about_the_game:
Play as a forgotten fox spirit trying to reclaim your place

Explore the domains of other fox spirits to gain essence and challenge them in turn-based battles. Once you’ve gained enough power, set your sights on defeating the Celestial Fox to stand above all fox spirits as the strongest.

It won’t be easy, but you can retry as many times as you need. Each attempt teaches you more, gradually revealing a path to victory.

Gameplay

This is a simplified RPG with turn-based battles. You’ll see a map with icons that you can click to “explore.” When you explore, text will describe what happens and present choices for how to proceed. Most choices help develop your character’s stats, and occasionally they will lead to battles.
